test: S-6 — does surface decay across an artifact while content does not?
IMPORTANT: a purpose-built construction, not the V5 world. The shared model has one decision stream and no creator-side budget; splitting it is new machinery and this repository is otherwise closed. Read it as what a two-stream creator does.

construction.note: both streams cost the same. The only difference is the cache.

what_would_have_falsified_it: content decaying as fast as surface for a practised creator, which would make the cache irrelevant; or a synthetic creator whose surface also declined, which would remove the positive machine signature and leave only an absence.
the_honest_caveat: this construction BUILDS IN the asymmetry it then measures: content is cached and surface is not. It is a consistency check on the theory's arithmetic, not evidence that real practice works this way. What it earns is the direction of the third prediction, which does not follow trivially: a budgetless creator is FLAT rather than merely high.
